definitions.explanation: Regarding someone or something as inferior or unworthy; treating with open disrespect.

examples.japanese: {他人|たにん}を{蔑視|べっし}してはいけない。
examples.english: You must not look down on others.

examples.japanese: {女性|じょせい}{蔑視|べっし}の{発言|はつげん}が{問題|もんだい}になった。
examples.english: A misogynistic remark became a problem.

examples.japanese: {人種|じんしゅ}{蔑視|べっし}は{社会|しゃかい}の{根深|ねぶか}い{問題|もんだい}であり、{教育|きょういく}を{通|つう}じて{解決|かいけつ}していく{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: Racial discrimination is a deep-rooted social problem that needs to be addressed through education.

notes:
Used as a suru-verb: {蔑視|べっし}する (to look down on, to scorn).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女性|じょせい}{蔑視|べっし} (misogyny, contempt for women)
- {人種|じんしゅ}{蔑視|べっし} (racial discrimination)
- {蔑視|べっし}する (to scorn, to despise)
- {蔑視的|べっしてき}な{態度|たいど} (a contemptuous attitude)

USAGE NOTE:
A formal, written-register word. In everyday speech, {見下|みくだ}す or {馬鹿|ばか}にする are more common equivalents. {蔑視|べっし} is frequently used in social criticism and academic writing.
